'''Mynock''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who lived during the [[war against Zakuul]]. When [[Mandalore the Avenger]] had agreed to help [[Raid on Darvannis|assist]] the [[Eternal Alliance]] and brought the clans to [[Darvannis]], Mynock was among those to answer her call.<ref name="KOTFE 14" />

In [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.2}}</ref> the warrior came to Mandalore's aid yet again, this time [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|battling]] forces of the [[Hidden Chain]] at their base on [[Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mynock first appeared in the Chapter XIV of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''.<ref name="KOTFE 14" /> This character was a cameo of a renowned cosplayer known as Mynock.<ref name="cameo">{{WebCite|url=https://todayintor.com/2022/12/15/mynock-cosplayer-ruhnuk-cameo/|text=Did You Know #101 – Mynock Cosplayer on Ruhnuk|archivedate=20230331193512}}</ref>
